name: OpenAI VDB Provider
description: This enables the use of OpenAI as a Vector Database in the AI module.
project_description: The OpenAI Vector Store provider integrates OpenAI's hosted Vector Store API with Drupal's AI Search / Search API, enabling semantic search powered by OpenAI's own embedding and retrieval infrastructure. Instead of running a vector database, this module uploads each Search API item to OpenAI as a Markdown file and lets OpenAI handle chunking, embedding generation and vector storage; searches are performed with a natural-language text query rather than a pre-computed vector, so the ai_search backend skips its own embedding call. It tracks the item-to-file mapping in a local database table, deduplicates uploads with a content checksum, polls each file to a terminal status, and reconciles drift on cron (retrying failed remote deletions and re-queuing items whose files vanished). Search API 'Filterable Attributes' become OpenAI attribute filters (max 16 per file, one reserved for the internal index_id). It requires the OpenAI AI provider and stores the API key via the Key module. NOTE: it is experimental / alpha and not yet production ready.
